executable.title: Build Pixel Classifier
executable.description: Train a pixel-level classifier from annotated whole-slide images. Reads a folder's items, finds slides assigned to each split via _pixelClassifierSplit item metadata, downloads each slide, reads the named annotation from each slide to collect positive patches, optionally constrains background sampling to an ROI annotation, trains a scikit-learn classifier head, evaluates on test/val splits, and posts results back to Girder.

string.name: folder_id
string.label: Experiment Folder ID
string.description: Girder folder containing the slides. Items with _pixelClassifierSplit metadata of "train", "test", or "val" are used for the respective splits.

string.name: positive_annotation_name
string.label: Annotation Name
string.description: Name of the annotation present on each slide whose polygon/shape elements mark the target structures. All elements inside matching annotations are used as positive patches.

string.name: roi_annotation_name
string.label: ROI Annotation Name
string.description: Optional. Name of an annotation on each slide whose polygon elements define the region of interest. Background patches are sampled only from inside this region (union of all polygons). Leave empty to sample from the entire slide.

string.name: session_name
string.label: Session Name
string.description: Name of the pixel classifier session (used for annotation and model item naming).

string-enumeration.name: model_type
string-enumeration.label: Model Type
string-enumeration.description: Classifier architecture. trident_linear: logistic regression on pre-computed TRIDENT patch embeddings. trident_mlp: MLP on TRIDENT embeddings. resnet_linear: logistic regression on GPU ResNet-18 features. random_forest: Random Forest on handcrafted features (CPU-only).

integer.name: magnification
integer.label: Magnification
integer.description: Target magnification level for patch extraction.

integer.name: n_estimators
integer.label: Number of Trees
integer.description: Number of trees for random_forest model type. Ignored otherwise.

string.name: job_dir
string.label: Output Directory
string.description: Container-internal path where model.pkl and training_report.json will be written.

string.name: output_folder_id
string.label: Results Folder
string.description: Girder folder ID where the model item will be created. Leave empty to use the invoking user's Private folder.

parameters.label: Girder API URL and Key
parameters.description: Auto-injected by Slicer CLI Web; do not set manually.
